Package com.j3d.engine.math

Class ScreenPoint

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.math.BasePoint<Integer>
com.j3d.engine.math.ScreenPoint
public class ScreenPoint extends BasePoint<Integer>
ScreenPoint, not to be confused with CartesianPoint, is a point on the actual screen (window) open. Where (0, 0) is the top left corner of the window.

All 2d points should be calculated in CartesianPoint, but when you want to show it on the screen, converted to a ScreenPoint

Lehlogonolo Poole
